_readme: CAPTURED OUTPUT OF js/schema.js. NOT A SECOND IMPLEMENTATION.
Every node in this file was produced by running the real pages in a
browser against the local dev server and copying out what schema.js
built. Nothing here was written by hand or derived from the markup by
any other code, which is the point: there is still exactly one thing
that knows how to build this graph.
tools/seo/bake-schema.ps1 reassembles each page's graph from `shared`
plus that page's own nodes, in the same order buildSchema() uses, and
checks the result against `sha256` below. A mismatch means the
reassembly is wrong and nothing is written.
TO REGENERATE: see the HOW TO RE-CAPTURE block at the top of
bake-schema.ps1. If js/config.js or js/schema.js changes, this file is
stale and tools/check.ps1 will fail until it is re-captured.
`sha256` is of the exact JSON string schema.js produced for that page.

webpage.name: Packers & Movers in Kanpur | Akash Movers
webpage.description: Home shifting, office relocation, packing and car transport in Kanpur. Our office is on Swaroop Nagar — surveyed first, quoted in writing, moved by our own crew.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a move?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a local move, about one to two weeks is comfortable. For an intercity move, two to three weeks gives us time to survey, confirm a vehicle and schedule the crew. We do take shorter-notice jobs when a vehicle is free, so it is always worth asking.

mainEntity.name: How is the cost of a move calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four things drive the figure: how much there is to move, how far it is going, how much packing you want us to do, and how hard the access is at each end — floor, lift and parking distance. We survey first and give you an itemised written quote, so you can see which part of the job costs what.

mainEntity.name: Do you pack everything, or should I pack some of it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Either works. Most customers have us pack the kitchen, glass and electronics and handle their own clothes and books, which brings the material and labour cost down. Tell us which rooms you want to do yourself and we will scope around it.

mainEntity.name: What happens if something is damaged during the move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Raise it with your coordinator at delivery, while the crew is still on site, and note it on the delivery sheet — that is what makes a claim straightforward later. The exact cover and claims process depends on the transit-insurance option you choose, which we confirm in writing with your quote before the move.

mainEntity.name: Can you move my car or bike as well?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Vehicles travel in a covered carrier rather than being driven across, so no distance is added to the odometer. We need the registration papers and the vehicle to be at roughly a quarter tank. It can run on the same booking as your household goods.

mainEntity.name: What if my new home is not ready on the delivery date?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us as early as you can and we will hold the consignment in storage and deliver when you are ready. Storage is charged separately from the move, by duration, and we confirm that rate before anything goes into the facility.

mainEntity.name: Which buildings are a problem — no lift, narrow stairs, tight parking?

acceptedAnswer.text: None of them are a problem if we know in advance. What causes delays is finding out on the day. During the survey we check the floor, the lift size, stair width and how far the truck can park from the door, and we plan the crew size and equipment around it.

mainEntity.name: Do you work on Sundays and public holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and for office relocations a weekend is usually the better choice, because it gives us two clear days to move and reconnect everything before staff return. Weekend slots fill earlier, so book ahead.

webpage.description: Straight answers on booking notice, how moving costs are worked out in Kanpur, packing, damage and claims, car transport, storage, and buildings with no lift.

We do take shorter-notice work when a vehicle is free, so it is always worth asking — but the last few days of the month book out first.

We survey first and quote in writing with those parts itemised, so you can see which one is costing you money.

mainEntity.name: Do you pack everything, or should I pack some of it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Either works. The most common arrangement is that we pack the kitchen, glassware and electronics, and you handle clothes, books and linen yourself. That brings both the material and the labour cost down without putting the breakable things at risk. Tell us which rooms you want to do and we will scope around it.

mainEntity.name: What happens if something is damaged during the move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Raise it with your coordinator at delivery, while the crew is still on site, and note it on the delivery sheet. That is what makes a claim straightforward later. The cover itself depends on the transit-insurance option you choose, which we confirm in writing with your quote before the move — ask for that detail rather than assuming goods are automatically insured, with us or with anyone.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Vehicles travel in a covered carrier rather than being driven, so no distance is added to the odometer. We need the registration papers and the tank at roughly a quarter full. It can run on the same booking as your household goods, and the vehicle's condition is photographed at both ends.

mainEntity.name: What if my new home is not ready on the delivery date?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us as early as you can and we will hold the consignment in storage and deliver when you are ready. Storage is charged separately from the move, by duration, and we confirm that rate before anything goes into the facility. Arranging it in advance always costs less than arranging it on the day.

mainEntity.name: My building has no lift and narrow stairs. Is that a problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not if we know in advance. What causes delays and extra cost is finding out on the day. During the survey we check the floor, the lift size, the stair width and how far the vehicle can park from the door, then plan the crew size and equipment around it. A fourth floor without a lift needs more people, not more hours.

mainEntity.name: Do you work on Sundays and public holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. For office relocations a weekend is usually the better choice, because it gives two clear days to move and reconnect everything before staff return. Weekend slots fill earlier, so book ahead.

mainEntity.name: Can you move plants, pets, or a gas cylinder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plants travel badly in a sealed vehicle over long distances and we will say so rather than take the money; for a local move they are usually fine. Pets should travel with you, not in the goods vehicle. Gas cylinders cannot be carried loaded — have the cylinder emptied and the connection removed by the supplier before the day.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be there on the day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Someone should be, at both ends, to sign the inventory and to say where things go. It does not have to be you — but it should be somebody who can make decisions, because "leave it, they will know" is how boxes end up in the wrong room.

mainEntity.name: How much notice do you need to cancel or reschedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us as soon as you know. A date moved with several days' notice is usually straightforward. Cancellation terms, including any charge once a vehicle and crew have been committed, are set out with your written quote — read that section before you accept, with us or with any mover.

mainEntity.name: Will one vehicle be enough for my things?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is exactly what the survey settles. Under-sizing the vehicle is the classic way a cheap quote becomes an expensive day, because a second trip is charged on top. We size the vehicle against the inventory and tell you which one we are sending.

webpage.name: Packers & Movers in Kanpur — home & office shifting
webpage.description: Shifting within Kanpur and out of it, run from our own office on Swaroop Nagar. The localities we cover, what Kanpur buildings and lanes actually require, and how a move here is priced.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover the whole of Kanpur?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — the city and its immediate outskirts, on both sides of the canal. Our office is on Swaroop Nagar, so nothing in Kanpur is far enough away to need a different crew. The areas listed above are the ones we work in most; if yours is not named, ask rather than assuming.

mainEntity.name: Can a truck reach my lane?

acceptedAnswer.text: In much of the older city, not a full-size one. That is a normal situation here and it has a normal answer: a smaller vehicle, more than one run, or a shuttle from a larger vehicle on the main road. What we will not do is turn up with the wrong vehicle and treat the extra work as your problem.

mainEntity.name: How much notice do you need?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a local move within Kanpur, often only a few days, because no long-distance vehicle has to be committed. Intercity moves are easier with a week or more, especially at month end when tenancies change over. Ask for your date — if a crew is free we will say so, and if not we will tell you instead of overbooking.

mainEntity.name: How is a Kanpur move priced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four things: the volume being moved, the distance, how much packing you want us to do, and the access at each address — floor, lift and how far the vehicle can park from the door. We survey first, in person or by video call, and the quote is issued in writing with those parts itemised. We do not publish a fixed rate card, because a moving price given without seeing the inventory is not a price anyone can be held to.

mainEntity.name: Can you move a car or a two-wheeler as well?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in a covered carrier rather than driven, with the condition photographed at both ends. It is usually arranged alongside a household move out of Kanpur. More on vehicle transport.

mainEntity.name: Where exactly is your office?

acceptedAnswer.text: 113/186, Swaroop Nagar, Kanpur 208002. You are welcome to come and talk it through in person before booking anything. Contact details and hours.

webpage.description: Home shifting, office relocation, local and intercity moving, car transport, packing, loading and storage in Kanpur. What each service includes and what drives its cost.

webpage.name: Home Shifting in Kanpur — full household moves
webpage.description: Full household shifting in Kanpur: room-by-room inventory, professional packing, furniture dismantled and reassembled, loaded, moved and placed in the new home.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 2 BHK take?

acceptedAnswer.text: With full packing, usually a day to pack and load and a second for delivery and reassembly on a local route — or the same day end to end if you have packed most of it yourself. The survey gives you a real answer for your flat rather than an average.

mainEntity.name: Can you move just a few rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Part-household moves are common — one bedroom's worth of furniture going to a different city, for example. It is priced on the inventory, not on the size of the flat it came from.

mainEntity.name: Will you take the packing material away?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you want it gone. We can unpack and remove the empty cartons and wrap on the same visit, or come back for them once you have unpacked at your own pace.

mainEntity.name: What about the fridge and washing machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Defrost and drain the fridge the night before, and drain the washing machine's hoses. We move them wrapped and upright. Appliances that need a technician to disconnect or install — a split AC, for example — are a separate job we can arrange.

webpage.name: Intercity Relocation from Kanpur — long-distance moving
webpage.description: City-to-city household relocation from Kanpur in a dedicated vehicle, with the driver's contact shared at dispatch and a delivery window agreed before departure.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the route and whether the load is dedicated or shared. We give you a window in writing before the vehicle leaves, based on that specific route, rather than a generic figure.

mainEntity.name: Can I track the vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get the driver's number at dispatch and progress updates from your coordinator on WhatsApp. If live GPS tracking is available on the vehicle assigned to you, we will tell you at booking rather than implying every vehicle has it.

mainEntity.name: Can my car go on the same booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Vehicle transport runs in a covered carrier and can be coordinated with your household goods so both arrive around the same time. See car and bike transport.

mainEntity.name: What if my new home is not ready when it arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us as early as you can and we will hold the consignment in storage and deliver when you are ready. Arranged in advance it costs noticeably less than arranging it on the day.

webpage.name: Loading & Unloading in Kanpur — labour only
webpage.description: Trained crews in Kanpur for loading and unloading when you have your own vehicle or have packed yourself. Trolleys and straps, stairs and no-lift buildings planned for.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire just the crew, with my own vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That is exactly what this service is. We will still advise on whether your vehicle is the right size, because a second trip costs more than the right truck would have.

mainEntity.name: Will you move things I packed myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Note that owner-packed cartons are normally outside transit cover, since nobody can verify the contents or the packing — so pack sturdy items yourself and consider having the fragile ones professionally packed.

mainEntity.name: How many people will come?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the volume, the floor and the lift. We state the crew size in the quote rather than sending "a team" and deciding on the day.

webpage.name: Local Shifting in Kanpur — same-city moves
webpage.description: Same-city shifting within Kanpur, usually finished in a single day. One crew end to end, a vehicle sized to your inventory, early starts to suit society timings.

mainEntity.name: Can you do it in one day?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most flats up to 3 BHK, yes — provided we can start early and the building allows it. Larger homes, or a fourth floor without a lift at either end, are more comfortable across two days. We will tell you honestly at survey which one yours is.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to pack anything myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, but packing your own clothes, books and linen is the easiest way to reduce a local quote, and those are the items least likely to be damaged in the process.

mainEntity.name: Can you move at short notice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes for local work, since no long-distance vehicle has to be committed. Ask — if a crew is free we will say so, and if not we will tell you rather than overbooking the day.

webpage.name: Office Relocation in Kanpur — commercial moving
webpage.description: Office and commercial relocation in Kanpur planned around your downtime: desks numbered to a new floor plan, IT reconnected, records in sealed crates, weekend slots.

mainEntity.name: Can you move us over a weekend so we do not lose a working day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and for most offices that is the right choice. Two clear days lets us move, rebuild and have IT reconnected before staff return. Weekend slots book out earliest, so fix the date well in advance.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle the servers and network equipment?

acceptedAnswer.text: We move the hardware safely, and we coordinate around your IT team's schedule. We do not present ourselves as network engineers: disconnection, racking and recommissioning should be done by whoever supports your infrastructure, and we plan the move sequence around them.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect confidential files?

acceptedAnswer.text: They go into sealed, numbered crates listed on their own manifest, signed out at the old office and signed in at the new one. If you need a specific chain-of-custody procedure, tell us at survey and we will work to it.

webpage.name: Packing & Unpacking Services in Kanpur
webpage.description: Professional packing in Kanpur with multi-layer wrapping, room-labelled cartons and bagged furniture hardware — plus unpacking and removal of packing waste.

mainEntity.name: Can you pack only the kitchen and breakables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is the most common arrangement we scope. Tell us which rooms you want to handle yourself and the quote is built around that split.

mainEntity.name: If I pack my own boxes, are they covered?

acceptedAnswer.text: Owner-packed cartons are normally excluded from transit cover, because nobody can verify what went in or how. That is true of movers generally, not just us — so pack the hard-to-damage things yourself and leave the fragile items to be professionally packed.

mainEntity.name: Do you take the empty cartons away?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you want. We can unpack and remove the waste on the same visit, or come back once you have unpacked at your own pace.

mainEntity.name: How many days before the move do you pack?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most homes, the day before, or the same morning for smaller flats. Larger houses with full packing may need two days. We agree the schedule at survey so you know which rooms become unusable and when.

webpage.name: Storage & Warehousing in Kanpur for household goods
webpage.description: Short and long-term storage for household and office goods in Kanpur, inventoried in and out, charged by duration, with the rate confirmed in writing first.

mainEntity.name: How is storage priced?

acceptedAnswer.text: By the volume held and the duration, separately from the move itself. You get the rate and the billing period in writing before anything goes in, so there is no open-ended charge running in the background.

mainEntity.name: Can I access my goods while they are stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is warehouse storage rather than a self-storage unit you hold a key to, so access is arranged on notice rather than on demand. If you expect to need regular access, tell us at booking — a self-storage unit may suit you better and we will say so.

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum period?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is usually a minimum billing period, which we confirm with your quote. Ask for it explicitly — a daily rate with a hidden monthly minimum is a common surprise in this industry.

mainEntity.name: Are stored goods insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storage cover is separate from transit cover and is not automatic. Ask what is included, what it excludes and what the limit is, and get it in writing before goods go in.

webpage.name: Car & Bike Transport in Kanpur — covered carriers
webpage.description: Cars and two-wheelers moved out of Kanpur in covered carriers rather than driven, with condition photographed at both ends. What papers you need and how it is priced.

mainEntity.name: Can my car be transported with my household goods?

acceptedAnswer.text: It travels on a vehicle carrier, not in the goods truck, but both can run on the same booking and be coordinated to arrive around the same time. One coordinator handles both.

mainEntity.name: Is the vehicle insured during transport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your own motor policy and any transit cover offered are separate things. Ask us what cover applies to the carrier and confirm with your insurer what your policy covers while the vehicle is being transported — do not assume either one covers everything.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect from my building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Where the lane allows a carrier, yes. Many residential streets do not, in which case we agree a nearby loading point. We check this at booking rather than discovering it on the day.

mainEntity.name: How are two-wheelers handled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motorcycles and scooters are crated or secured upright on stands and strapped at the frame. Mirrors are usually folded or removed to avoid contact in transit.
